analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (109,285 KRW) vs SMA5 (106,323 KRW) / SMA20 (107,569 KRW) / SMA50 (106,156 KRW): Diagnosing short- to mid-term trend above.
· Position relative to SMA100 (115,915 KRW) / SMA200 (95,338 KRW): Mixed mid- to long-term trend, maintaining strength above SMA200.
· 52-week position (59.2%) + Current price level historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (52.1 → 52.7) + Neutral sustained diagnosis + Gradual upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (754.2302 → 30.9417) + Improvement diagnosis + Strengthening trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Mid-band 107,569 KRW) + Bandwidth 9.26% at normal levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (100,000 KRW) + Confirmed support based on Pivot S1 (101,437 KRW).
· Swing resistance (110,910 KRW) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day / 20-day high-low pattern (Higher Low) + Interpreting recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x) + Subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Entry conditions met, wait-and-see conditions not met.
